_metadata.description: MAN TGS 32.430 8x4 BB CH twin-steer tipper chassis (UK, 2022, NN cab, wheelbase 3205). First real-vehicle multi-axle example: axle positions, weights, tyres, suspension types, turning circle and driveline are published; geometry details and rates are estimates.
_metadata.author: RFloEng

data_origin.detail: Published by MAN (body-builder chassis sheet): axle spacings L1/L2/L3, overhangs, width across rear tyres, frame height, unladen and plated group loads, tyres, rims, suspension types, engine, gearbox ratios, axle ratio, turning circle. Estimated (_est): hardpoints, tracks, CG, spring/damper/stabiliser rates, masses of axles, twin-steer ratio, steering gear geometry.

x_sources.title: MAN Truck & Bus UK, TGS 8X4 Normal Height Tipper chassis specification, MAN TGS 8X4RIGTIP / 10, May 2022

vehicle_info.variant: Normal height tipper chassis, NN cab, WB 3205

chassis._mass_total_source: Unladen weight 9432 kg (front axles 6359 + rear axle 3073), standard specification, full fuel and AdBlue, incl. driver, ±2.5 %
chassis._wheelbase_source: L1 'Wheelbase' 3205 mm, measured from the second steer axle to the first drive axle in MAN's dimension drawing
chassis._track_note: Estimated. track_rear derived from published B1 width across rear tyres 2462 mm minus tyre section width and estimated dual spacing.
chassis._cg_note: x derived from published group kerb loads assuming an even split within each group; height estimated for the bare chassis-cab.

plated_masses._source: Plated/operating weights: GVW 34000 kg design, 32000 kg UK legal

chassis_stiffness._note: Ladder frame S500MC, 270 x 85 x 7 mm, 942-762 mm waisted (published); torsional stiffness is a low estimate typical of truck ladder frames

engine._source: D2676LFAJ Euro 6: 430 PS at 1800 rpm, 2200 Nm at 930-1350 rpm, 12419 cc, 6 cylinders. 600 rpm point estimated; 1800 rpm torque derived from rated power (316 kW).
